discoveredIssues.description: `f1-1-minikube-backend`: `engine/scripts/cluster-up.sh` restores the saved kube context on EXIT, so `run-scenario.sh` can execute later kubectl/helm steps against the caller's previous cluster instead of the freshly created chart-test-swarm cluster.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Keep the scenario workflow pinned to the newly created context (or pass explicit `--context` everywhere) and only restore the caller context after the full scenario lifecycle is complete.

discoveredIssues.description: `f1-1-minikube-backend`: `engine/scripts/run-scenario.sh` only tears down failed/interrupted runs when `KEEP_CLUSTER=0`, which violates the feature's required failure/interrupt cleanup behavior.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Always tear down on failure and signal paths, and reserve `KEEP_CLUSTER=1` only for successful runs or an explicitly documented debug mode.

discoveredIssues.description: `f1-2-raw-manifest-preinstall`: `engine/scripts/apply-scenario.sh` adds `--namespace` for `raw_manifest` items but never creates that namespace first, so namespaced raw-manifest scenarios fail on a fresh cluster.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Mirror the helm preinstall path by creating the target namespace when a raw-manifest item declares one and it does not already exist.

discoveredIssues.description: `f1-3-integration-category-reorg`: `engine/testgrid/tests/test_integration_reorg.py` hard-codes pre-reorg SHA-256 hashes for moved primers, which will make valid later primer rewrites fail.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Replace the permanent hash freeze with a one-time migration assertion or a structural reorg check that does not block later intentional content changes.

discoveredIssues.description: `f1-4-reports-artifact-contract`: the artifact bundle is not replayable from `artifacts/` alone because `scenario.yaml` keeps source-tree-relative references and the bundle does not vendor enough inputs to reproduce the release from `PROJECT_DIR=<artifacts>`.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Vendor the chart and referenced fixtures into the artifact bundle (or rewrite the scenario to point at vendored copies) and verify replay with an actual `apply-scenario.sh` run from the copied artifacts directory.

discoveredIssues.description: `f1-4-reports-artifact-contract`: `artifacts/applied-overrides.yaml` does not materialize one final merged `helm_values` map; it appends separate values-file and `product.set` fragments, leaving the artifact ambiguous when both sources are present.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Compute the final merged override mapping before writing the artifact, for example via `yq` merge logic or a Helm-rendered values synthesis step.

suggestedChanges: Clarify whether scrutiny reviewers should always assess the current working tree or the original feature commit when the validator lands a small local fix during the scrutiny pass.

Consider documenting an explicit fallback when an auxiliary reviewer droid (for example `python-reviewer`) is misconfigured, so validators know whether to retry, substitute another reviewer, or just record the environment issue.
